system_prompt:
당신은 조선 세종대 실록 기사에 관한 질문에 답한다.
아래 [자료]에 주어진 기사 조각만 근거로 답하라. 자료 밖의 지식을 쓰지 마라.
답변 형식: 짧은 답 하나. 단어나 짧은 구로만 답하고 설명·근거 표기는 쓰지 않는다. 답할 수 없으면 '근거 부족'이라고만 쓴다.
smoke_test: the first five items were answered in a pipeline smoke-test call with identical settings and are included in the 975

retrieval.method: dense retrieval only: cosine similarity between the question embedding and GraphRAG text-unit embeddings, top 10; no graph, reranking or query rewriting
retrieval.chunks: the 4,600 GraphRAG text units of the released index settings (1,200 tokens, overlap 100, o200k_base, split at article boundaries), i.e. the same units as Basic Search
retrieval.embedding_model: text-embedding-3-small (text-unit vectors from the GraphRAG LanceDB store; question vectors from the same model)
